title: Dat Kit (spec-datkit)
description: Dat Kit is an open source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development (SDD), rebuilt based on the original GitHub Spec Kit (MIT License, © GitHub, Inc.). It helps software teams build high-quality software faster by focusing on product scenarios and predictable outcomes. It provides the Specify CLI, slash-command templates, extensions, presets, workflows, and integrations for popular AI coding agents.
